purpose_context: doc-kitty promises human-first, agent-supported docs. This mission makes a page state who it is for, what to read next, and what it draws on — turning frontmatter the earlier missions already validate into readable, accessible on-page blocks, with persona pages that give audiences a home and a shared citation catalog so a source is described once and cited consistently everywhere.
purpose_tldr: Render each page's intended audience, related pages, and cited references as consistent, accessible on-page blocks, backed by persona pages and a shared citation catalog.
